verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own docs show a general risk-management workflow: the SOC 2 Launchpad has you "action policies, risks, and evidence", the getting-started guide covers "manage risks", and there is a Continuous Risk Monitoring page (title only). None of this shows the register's structure. Scoring, owners and due-date tracking are documented only for the separate AI-systems and vendor modules, which are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented risk scoring and methodology for the general register, treatment plans, per-risk owners, periodic review cycles, explicit risk-to-control mapping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
